assertion.statement: Karpenter v1.0.0 (listed as a bug fix) now uses ScheduleAnyway instead of DoNotSchedule.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: the note names only the values ScheduleAnyway/DoNotSchedule; it does not identify the Karpenter component, CRD field, chart key, flag or mechanism that carries them; applicability: the single release-note line does not say where or when DoNotSchedule was used (no field, resource kind, workload type, setting or component is named), so no environmental exposure condition can be derived; consequence: the note lists this only as a bug fix; it does not state what fails, is rejected, changes, or must be migrated for environments that relied on the previous DoNotSchedule usage
